description: Create BottomNav component and update layout shell (DashboardShell, Header) to be fully mobile responsive. This is the foundation that all other FEATs depend on.
steps: CREATE src/components/layout/BottomNav.tsx — mobile-only fixed bottom nav (md:hidden). Props: role: UserRole, items: NavItem[], activeTab?: string, onTabChange?: (id: string) => void, accent?: string. Internally filter items to at most 5 per role using BOTTOM_NAV_ITEMS map: operator=['overview','live','alerts','sensors','ai'], planner=['overview','map','history','trends','intelligence'], regulator=['overview','portfolio','review','health','reports']. Each button: icon (size-5) + label (text-[9px] uppercase). Active item coloured with accent prop. Add a 2px accent-coloured top border indicator on active item. Root nav: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 bg-[#1a2035] border-t border-white/10 flex items-stretch, with style paddingBottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px). Export NavItem interface (re-exports Sidebar's interface shape).

MODIFY src/components/layout/DashboardShell.tsx: (a) Import BottomNav from './BottomNav'. (b) Change inner scroll div from 'flex-1 overflow-auto p-6' to 'flex-1 overflow-auto p-3 sm:p-6 pb-20 md:pb-6' so content is not hidden under the bottom nav on mobile. (c) Change page-header bar padding from 'px-6 py-4' to 'px-3 sm:px-6 py-3 sm:py-4'. (d) On the page-header bar's content, the title div and the live-status pill already use flex-wrap — keep it. (e) Render <BottomNav role={role} items={nav} activeTab={activeTab} onTabChange={onTabChange} accent={accent} /> after <FloatingAIChat /> inside the outer flex column.

MODIFY src/components/layout/Header.tsx: In the logo block, wrap the subtitle 'Mine Safety Sentinel' span with 'hidden sm:block' class so on very narrow phones (<640px) only the logo image and BHURAKSHAK text show, preventing header overflow.
acceptance_criteria: BottomNav appears at bottom of screen on mobile (< 768px), is hidden at md+
BottomNav shows correct 5 items per role with icons and labels
Tapping a bottom nav item switches the active tab (onTabChange fires)
Active item is highlighted in role accent colour
Main content area scrolls without any content hidden under the bottom nav
npm run build completes with zero TypeScript errors
verification: Run: cd 'd:\BHURAKSHAK GIT' && npm run build
Zero TypeScript errors and zero build errors
findings: Build succeeded with zero TypeScript errors (3318 modules transformed). BottomNav.tsx created with role-aware 5-item filtering and iOS safe-area support. DashboardShell updated with BottomNav import, responsive padding (pb-20 md:pb-6, px-3 sm:px-6, py-3 sm:py-4), and BottomNav rendered after FloatingAIChat. Header subtitle hidden on sm breakpoint (hidden sm:block) to prevent overflow on narrow phones.
